notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Configure Slack alerts and background quota refresh.
notifications.slack_description: Send alerts to your Slack channel via webhook.
notifications.webhook_step_1: Open Slack API and create a new app.
notifications.webhook_step_2: Select 'From Scratch', name your app, and choose a workspace.
notifications.webhook_step_3: In the sidebar, open 'Incoming Webhooks' and turn it on.
notifications.webhook_step_4: Click 'Add New Webhook to Workspace', select a channel, and copy the URL.
notifications.webhook_help: When account data refreshes, a digest of available accounts is sent to Slack. Duplicate messages for the same reset cycle are skipped.
notifications.scheduled_description: Slack delivers scheduled messages even when this app is closed.
notifications.enable_scheduled_detail: Schedule Slack messages for account reset times.
notifications.bot_mission: 🔑 Get a bot token and channel ID
notifications.bot_step_1: Open your Slack app, or create one if needed.
notifications.bot_step_2_detail: Add the 'chat:write' scope under Bot Token Scopes.
notifications.bot_step_3: Install or reinstall the app in your workspace.
notifications.bot_step_3_detail: Copy the Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-...).
notifications.bot_step_4: Right-click a Slack channel, open 'View channel details', and copy its Channel ID.
notifications.scheduled_help: ℹ️ Uses Slack's chat.scheduleMessage API. Messages remain on Slack until delivery.

about.getting_started_detail: Authorize each account with its provider before adding it here.
about.antigravity_steps:
1. Install the Antigravity extension in your IDE (VS Code or JetBrains).
2. Sign in with Google in the IDE.
3. Return here and click (+) to add the account.
about.antigravity_models: Tracks Gemini, Claude, and GPT-OSS usage.
about.codex_steps:
1. Sign in to OpenAI Codex.
2. Open the Codex tab and click (+).
3. Choose "Login with OpenAI (OAuth)" to authorize in your browser.
4. Choose "Login with OpenAI (Web Session)" to sign in through the embedded browser.
about.tips_detail:
• Use Anonymous to hide personal information.
• Click ↻ on an account to refresh it.
• Use Cancel if a login gets stuck.
• Account data stays on this device.
about.footer: Made with ❤️ for AI power users
